_comment: Fetched by the app on every launch. Edit, commit, push - no APK update needed.
_dataBaseUrl: Origin whose listing HTML the native home parses. If it stops working the app auto-discovers the current origin via the mirror links on homeUrl.
_nativeHome: Kill switch. false = launch straight into the WebView on homeUrl (v1.x behaviour).
_playerCss: Injected into stream pages opened from the native home. Empty = use the app's built-in default (RemoteConfig.DEFAULT_PLAYER_CSS). Only set this to hot-fix the player layout without shipping an APK; a value here overrides every app version.
_playerViewportWidth: CSS px width stream pages are laid out at in the player (desktop layout, scaled to fit). 0 = leave the site's own viewport.
